title: English Practice Quiz 0237
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.
